Definition: to liquefy; figuratively, to waste (with disease), to faint (with fatigue, fear or grief)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to dissolve, melt; 1a) (Qal) to waste away; 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to melt, vanish, drop off, melt away; 1b2) to faint, grow fearful (fig.); 1b3) wasted, worthless (participle); 1c) (Hiphil) to cause to melt
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
